# WHAT THE PUBLIC SITE IS MADE OF — the deploy allow-list.
#
# Every line is a PATTERN matched against the files in this repository. A file
# is published only if it matches one. Nothing else is copied — not a stray
# note, not a backup, not a new tooling file, wherever it sits.
#
# PATTERNS ARE FILE-LEVEL, ON PURPOSE. An earlier version of this list named
# DIRECTORIES and copied them recursively, which made the boundary default-deny
# at the top level and default-ALLOW inside anything listed: `portal/` was
# allowed, so `portal/anything-at-all.txt` would have been published. That is
# the same failure this list exists to prevent, one level down. Name files.
#
#   *   matches within one path segment
#   **  matches zero or more whole segments
#
# Live is served from the repo root, so a published path appears at the same
# path on the domain: `intake/index.html` -> /intake/.
#
# ADDING A PAGE OR ASSET: add it here, or it is not published. The stager fails
# if a pattern matches NOTHING, so a renamed or deleted page is caught at build
# time rather than by someone finding a 404 weeks later.
#
# NOT LISTED, DELIBERATELY: .claude (agent definitions), .github (workflows,
# this file, the stager and its test), case-portal (Worker source, PRICING.md
# and every handoff note), visitor-alerts (Worker source), build-locations.py
# (the generator — its OUTPUT is the site, not the script), CLAUDE.md,
# README.md, .gitignore, and every test suite.

# --- Cloudflare Pages configuration -----------------------------------------
_headers
_redirects

# --- the site itself ---------------------------------------------------------
index.html
404.html
privacy.html
robots.txt
sitemap.xml
beacon.js
.well-known/security.txt

# --- images and brand assets -------------------------------------------------
# Named one by one, not `assets/*.webp`. A wildcard here would publish whatever
# lands in this directory next, unreviewed — and an images folder is exactly
# where a case photograph gets dropped "just to look at it". Adding a brand
# asset is a deliberate line in this file.
assets/banner1.webp
assets/logo-white.webp
assets/logo-lockup.svg
assets/review1.webp
assets/review2.webp
assets/review3.webp

# --- service pages -----------------------------------------------------------
insurance-investigations/index.html
insurance-investigations/vendor-information/index.html
infidelity-investigations/index.html
child-custody-investigations/index.html

# --- generated location pages ------------------------------------------------
# THE ONE WILDCARD IN THIS FILE, and it is deliberate. build-locations.py
# generates these from its PLACES list, and build-locations.yml regenerates,
# commits and deploys them on its own. Naming each city here would mean a new
# market silently failed to publish until someone remembered this file — the
# generator's whole point is that it does not need remembering.
#
# It is kept as tight as it can be: exactly one directory deep, and the
# filename is fixed, so the only thing it can ever publish is a location page.
private-investigator/index.html
private-investigator/*/index.html

# --- the intake form ---------------------------------------------------------
intake/index.html

# --- the staff case portal: a PAGE, never the Worker (noindex) ---------------
portal/index.html
portal/manifest.webmanifest
portal/icon-180.png
portal/icon-192.png
portal/icon-512.png

# --- the private visitor dashboard (noindex) ---------------------------------
watch/index.html
watch/manifest.webmanifest
watch/sw.js
watch/icon-180.png
watch/icon-192.png
